status: development-contract-only; do not start observer tuning until V14a canonical phase artifact exists
fixed_from_v14a: sufficient-statistic family used to define V14a phase geometry

alternating_freeze_rule.target_pass: freeze nuisance observer and all world/oracle definitions; only target representation may change
alternating_freeze_rule.nuisance_pass: freeze target observer and all world/oracle definitions; only nuisance representation may change
alternating_freeze_rule.forbidden: never update both observers from the same contradiction batch

definition_defect.action: revise the scientific definition in a new explicit definition generation; do not tune either observer to preserve the old label

representation_defect.action: change only the currently unfrozen observer whose representation failed

information_absent.action: do not predict through the gap; retain UNDETERMINED and route the limitation to measurement-window/sensor design

process_coupling.action: do not force exclusivity; retain simultaneous process support and test whether coupling supplies indirect target evidence

contradiction_seeking.rule: sample predicted phase-transition and low-margin regions deliberately rather than waiting for random contradictions
must_include: Pi2 around 1 with weak other separation

stop_rule.operational_default: stop V14b after three consecutive contradiction-seeking batches add zero new contradiction signature types, provided every required transition stratum has been sampled in those batches
stop_rule.rate_rule: residual contradiction rate is recorded but is not a stopping target
stop_rule.warning: a continuing monotonic fall in residual rate after type saturation is flagged as possible ambiguity absorption/overfitting and cannot by itself justify further tuning

measurement_transition.on_stop: freeze both observer implementations and all thresholds/hashes
measurement_transition.V14c_rule: measure residual indeterminacy and contradiction surfaces without further observer modification
